walkthroughs.body_html:
Area C: The World Around Us — a core area of GCSE German.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Area C: The World Around Us brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Area C: The World Around Us.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: How do you say 'I will drink coffee tomorrow' in German?
options: Ich gehe Kaffee trinken morgen.
Ich will Kaffee morgen trinken.
Heute is always followed by a verb.
Ich werde morgen Kaffee trinken.

mcqs.q: In 'Heute gehe ich ins Kino', why does 'gehe' come second?
options: German is a V2 language - the conjugated verb is the second element in main clauses.
Heute is always followed by a verb.
Word order is free.
Ich gehe Kaffee trinken morgen.

mcqs.q: How do you say 'I get up early' using 'aufstehen'?
options: Ich aufstehe früh.
Heute is always followed by a verb.
Ich stehe aufruh.
Ich stehe früh AUF.
